attempts.finalSql:
SELECT v.clinical_significance AS pathogenicity_class,
       ROUND(AVG(vc.alt_read_count::numeric / NULLIF(vc.total_read_count, 0)) FILTER (WHERE vc.filter_status = 'PASS' AND vc.total_read_count >= 20), 3) AS avg_allele_fraction
FROM world_cup.genomics.variant_calls vc
JOIN world_cup.genomics.variants v ON vc.variant_id = v.id
JOIN world_cup.genomics.samples s ON vc.sample_id = s.id
WHERE s.is_control = false
GROUP BY v.clinical_significance
ORDER BY v.clinical_significance;

sql.sql:
SELECT v.clinical_significance AS pathogenicity_class,
       ROUND(AVG(vc.alt_read_count::numeric / NULLIF(vc.total_read_count, 0)) FILTER (WHERE vc.filter_status = 'PASS' AND vc.total_read_count >= 20), 3) AS avg_allele_fraction
FROM world_cup.genomics.variant_calls vc
JOIN world_cup.genomics.variants v ON vc.variant_id = v.id
JOIN world_cup.genomics.samples s ON vc.sample_id = s.id
WHERE s.is_control = false
GROUP BY v.clinical_significance
ORDER BY v.clinical_significance;

attempts.answer:
Average alternate-allele fraction by pathogenicity class (to three decimals):
- BENIGN: 0.425
- LIKELY_BENIGN: 0.432
- LIKELY_PATHOGENIC: 0.423
- PATHOGENIC: 0.283
- VUS: 0.416

Comparisons:
- Highest: LIKELY_BENIGN (0.432); lowest: PATHOGENIC (0.283); range = 0.149.
- Non-pathogenic categories (BENIGN, LIKELY_BENIGN, LIKELY_PATHOGENIC, VUS) cluster tightly between 0.416 and 0.432 (spread 0.016).
- LIKELY_BENIGN is slightly higher than BENIGN by 0.007.

Takeaway:
- Pathogenic variants exhibit a markedly lower average alternate-allele fraction than other classes in this dataset.

Source entities/fields:
- Tables: world_cup.genomics.variant_calls, world_cup.genomics.variants, world_cup.genomics.samples
- Fields/filters: variants.clinical_significance; variant_calls.alt_read_count/total_read_count, filter_status = 'PASS' and total_read_count ≥ 20; samples.is_control = false.
